description: Implementation of the ProductPriceService interface for managing ProductPrice entities, including methods for adding descriptions, saving or updating prices, and deleting prices within the sales manager project.

classes.name: ProductPriceServiceImpl
classes.description: Service layer implementation for handling business logic related to ProductPrice entities, extending generic service functionality and implementing specific methods for product pricing.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to the given ProductPrice and updates the entity.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new or updates an existing ProductPrice, handling associated descriptions accordingly.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a ProductPrice after re-fetching it to ensure it is attached.
